extracted.intended_audience: Swiss early-career researchers, host institutions, and SNSF stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of an external evaluation of the SNSF Ambizione funding scheme, reporting how the scheme affects grantees' independence, careers, and host-institute benefits and recommending improvements (notably grant duration).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness in promoting scientific independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Ambizione is an effective funding scheme that helps grantees to become more independent and boosts their careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The evaluation concluded that receiving an Ambizione grant positively affects the careers of young researchers and contributes to their scientific independence (based on an online survey of grantees and host institutes and interviews with former grant holders).

rubrics_metrics.name: Career progression, visibility, and competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Being an award, it increases the visibility and competitiveness of grantees on the academic labour market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ambizione's status as an award is cited as a mechanism by which grantees gain greater market competitiveness and visibility, contributing to career advancement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benefits to host institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: The funding scheme is an asset for the host institutes, expanding their scientific profiles and the additional research activities linked to Ambizione.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host institutes report that Ambizione projects help broaden institutional research profiles and generate extra research activity tied to the grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support from host institutes (infrastructure and additional funding)
rubrics_metrics.description: Most respondents are happy with the support they receive from host institutes, be it in the form of infrastructure or through additional funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level and type of host-institute support (infrastructure, extra funding) is a dimension of satisfaction in the evaluation and a factor in the scheme's effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Achievement of scheme targets
rubrics_metrics.description: All important targets have been met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SNSF states satisfaction with the report's overall conclusion that the scheme achieves its main goals; this is an aggregate evaluative claim about target attainment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding period adequacy (duration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondents were less satisfied with the funding period; a key recommendation is extending Ambizione grants from three to four years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duration of funding is identified as a primary area for improvement; the SNSF will examine this recommendation for inclusion in the forthcoming multi-year programme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation methodology / evidence base
rubrics_metrics.description: The evaluators carried out an online survey among all Ambizione grantees and their host institutes as well as a number of interviews with former grant holders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Findings and recommendations are grounded in surveys of grantees and host institutions plus qualitative interviews; this evidentiary approach frames the weight and generalizability of conclusions.
